lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na2Mg2Mn6O16 (reduced formula NaMgMn3O8) crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn and Na in octahedral environments coordinated by six O neighbors, while Mg also shows six O neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by combinations of Mg, Mn, and Na. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra and between Mg and Mn polyhedra, with an additional face-sharing Mn–Na octahedral pair.
